item.text: I’m untangling the shuffled text into its initial state, six ordered operations, and the exact three-line output contract. The key is to preserve the distinction between moving contents and changing visible labels.

A useful structural clue emerged: every token appears exactly twice, so the visible paragraph is two duplicate instruction sets shuffled together. I’m checking whether it is a reversible interleaving; if so, that recovers the numbered operations instead of guessing their order.

The final colors cannot be determined uniquely: the shuffle erased which operations correspond to steps 1–6, and different valid orderings produce different results. Please resend the six numbered operations in order.
